description: Prepares one change and returns a plain summary of exactly what it would do, with a preview_id. Changes nothing: the change happens only when that preview_id is confirmed. Without an account: book_appointment (code; body service_type, selected_slot exactly as booking_options returned it, location_id, property_details {someone_home_during_service, ok_to_proceed_without_customer, pets_on_property, gated_community, gate_code, dog_access_considerations, access_instructions}, expected_total_cents, promo_code), reschedule_appointment (code; body selected_slot from reschedule_options), cancel_appointment (code; body reason), request_quote (body contact {first_name, last_name, email, phone, sms_consent: true when the customer agreed to texts, consent_label}, address {line1, line2, city, state, zip, country}, service_title in the customer's words, panel_count, notes, source) and request_inspection (body: the contact and address the times were found for, service_type, selected_slot, promo_code, notes). A connected customer passes site_id instead of code for the three appointment changes, and also has: save_access_details (body property_details), reject_quote (id; body reason, lost_reason), connect_system (provider; body fields: the fields the connect_system view lists for that provider), disconnect_system (provider), set_energy_rate (body currency, importRatePerKwh, exportRatePerKwh as decimal strings), change_subscription_tier (body targetTier, billingInterval), cancel_subscription (body cancelAtPeriodEnd), resume_subscription, withdraw_document (id), update_notification_settings (body: the settings to change, as notification_settings names them), request_lease_offer (id; body language), accept_lease_offer (id; body quote_id). payment_method, payment, sign_document, lease_bank_account and subscribe are not carried out by this connector: previewing one returns the portal link where the customer does it themselves. Serves every Otovo region: without a connected account the scheduling code, preview or address selects the region; a connected customer is served where their account lives.

body.description: The change's details, exactly as the tool description names them for that change.

change.description: The one change to preview. See the tool description for what each takes in body.

code.description: Without an account: the customer's scheduling code, the last part of the otovo.com/book/... link they were sent. It cannot be looked up from other details.

id.description: The record the change is about: a quote (reject_quote), document envelope (withdraw_document) or lease project (request_lease_offer, accept_lease_offer).

provider.description: connect_system, disconnect_system: the provider key from get_my_otovo view connect_system.

site_id.description: Connected customers: one of their own sites, a site_id from view sites. Needed when they have more than one.

name: preview_change
title: Preview a change
